description: Explain a status shown in Refapp for a candidate, project or background check. Accepts the status as shown in the app in any of Refapp's languages (e.g. "Försenade", "Review needed") or its internal name (e.g. "overdue"). Returns the label in every language and what it means; when nothing matches, lists the known statuses.
name: explain_status
title: Explain a Refapp status
